structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a PumpSwap pool named "Super Intelligence" ($SI). It is about 40 minutes old, was not launched from a pump.fun curve (the address has no "pump" suffix and the launchpad field is empty), and its LP is 0% locked. It was deployed about two days after Trump told the UN on 2026-09-22 that AI would be renamed "super intelligence" (SI). In its first hour the pool traded about $4M against a market cap of about $110k and liquidity of about $150k, so liquidity is larger than the market cap. GeckoTerminal counts 1,958 unique buyers but only 56 unique sellers, who made about 2,580 sells between them. GMGN flags 49 bundler wallets holding about 23%. At least 3 near-identical "Super Intelligence" PumpSwap pools launched in the prior 2 hours: ESwAE… ($6.5M h1 volume on $124k mcap and $206k liquidity), 12WKrr… ($9.5M h6 volume, liquidity now shown as $0) and 68UVL… (liquidity $57, dead). This looks like a serial volume-farm launch pattern riding the news, not organic demand for this contract. Media identify the ticker's canonical meme coin as Super Inu (SI, about $6M mcap), not this token.

narrative.description: Trump's UN speech on 2026-09-22 declared that AI would be renamed 'super intelligence' and that US documents would say 'SI'. Mainstream outlets covered it widely (WaPo, Axios, The Hill) and it drew reactions on X. It is real, a meme-friendly story, and 2 days old.
narrative.why_spreading: A presidential soundbite that invites mockery, with a ready-made ticker (SI). The first-mover coin, Super Inu, already ran 300%+ to a market cap of about $7-9M according to KuCoin and ChainCatcher flash news, and that spawned dozens of copycats.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond the name. There is no website, no DexScreener profile and no socials. The only link is a tweet from gum_xbt, a recycled X account formerly called solgummies. I found no mention of this contract address anywhere.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Super Inu SI (DEW9…, about $6M mcap, which crypto news treats as the canonical SI coin). Another 'Super Intelligence' at 82ez…pump ($554k mcap). Copycat PumpSwap pools with the same pattern: ESwAE… (bigger volume), 12WKrr… (liquidity $0) and 68UVL… (dead). There are several others.

authenticity.evidence: The hour's volume is 26x the market cap. Buyers outnumber sellers about 1,958 to 56 by unique wallet, with about 2,580 sells coming from those 56 wallets. GMGN flags 49 bundlers holding 23%. LP is unlocked and the deployer holds it, and liquidity is larger than the market cap. Sibling pools with the same name, launched hours earlier, show the same volume profile, and at least one or two already show liquidity near zero. The project X account is recycled.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer count could include some real retail wallets drawn in by trending lists. I could not see the tweet content because X returned HTTP 402.

structural_risks: The deployer can pull the unlocked LP at any time, and that LP is about $150k, more than the market cap
It appears to be a serial copycat launcher; sibling pools already show liquidity near zero
Most of the volume looks wash-traded or bot-driven, with very few unique sellers
Dozens of same-name clones compete for the same attention

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is real and fresh. With about 2,000 buyer wallets and $4M of volume, this pool could be the copycat that trending lists catch, and at a $110k market cap a double to $230k only needs modest real inflow. Some farm pools are held for hours while the operator harvests fees, and price can spike during that time.
unknowns: Who the deployer is and how it links to the sibling pools (I did not trace this on-chain)
The content of the gum_xbt tweet
Whether the $0 liquidity on 12WKrr is a real pull or a display glitch

source_coverage.notes: X search found only news and reactions about the Trump rename, nothing about this contract address. Fetching the gum_xbt tweet failed with HTTP 402. The contract address search returned nothing. DexScreener API data covered this pool and its siblings. I did not run a separate Telegram or Discord search, but no socials exist in the packet.

structured_output.thesis: This is a clone of an established ticker, riding a real but 2-day-old Trump soundbite. It shows volume-farm signatures: 56 unique sellers against about 2,000 buyers, 26x turnover, and liquidity above market cap with an unlocked LP. Sibling pools from what is likely the same operator are already dying. The chance of a genuine 2x before a pull is low, and the rug risk is high.
